Against it, and I think it outweighs the above: the 30-minute high has already been drawn down 43%, and the last 15 minutes show sells nearly matching buys (425 of 435 SOL). Early post-graduation sell pressure was heavy (sell/buy ratio 0.97), and bundling is high at 43%, with the completer taking 25%. Given the ~20% base-rate loss on random buys in this window and the 1.4-5.1% round-trip cost, the edge is not clear enough to justify a $20 ticket.

Verdict: no strong case to buy now. Skip unless a fresh signal appears, such as net flow turning clearly positive over several minutes.
memos.skeptic:
The most likely way this loses money is insider distribution after a sharp drop. The coin is already 42.6% off its 30-minute high despite a 64% gain over the window, and the last 15 minutes show sells of 424.85 SOL against 434.79 bought, with a sell-to-buy ratio of 0.97 right after graduation. That looks like early holders exiting into retail demand.

The curve data adds risk: 43% of supply sits in bundled wallets, and the completer holds 25%. The launch bot present in the first two minutes points the same way. With 103 SOL of pool depth, a $20 ticket faces roughly 1.4-5.1% round-trip cost, so a small bounce won't cover fees. Net flow of only +9.9 SOL over 15 minutes shows the volume is churn, not accumulation.

Verdict: skip.
